mentions.note: born 20 March 1909; Editor of Athletics Weekly; Belgrave member during the war; now at the head of Belgrave's membership list; founder of Athletics (Dec 1945, later Athletics Weekly) and Editor for 22 years; Master Coach; 87th birthday 20 April 1996; no. 31 in the 1948 Poly Marathon

photos.c: P.W. "Jimmy" Green as pictured on the Editorial page of the very first edition of Athletics. The photo actually dates from his R.A.F. days in 1930.
Left: Reporting the 1964 Tokyo Olympics with his successor as Athletics Weekly Editor, Mel Watman.
Above: "Jimmy" presents the "AW" 10 mile Two-Man Relay Trophy to a youthful Portsmouth AC pairing of Bruce Tulloh and Martin Hyman

Left: It's Poly Marathon day, 19th June 1948, and her Majesty The Queen is introduced to some of the runners before they set out on their 26 mile journey from Windsor to Chiswick. Cecil Ballard, of Surrey A.C. is presented to Her Majesty with "Jimmy", no. 31, next in line.
